confirm.description: Add the scale {name}? Readings arrive passively from its advertisements; nothing connects to it.

user.title: Add a BLE scale
user.description: Only scales advertising right now are listed. These scales sleep between weigh-ins, so step on yours and try again if the list is empty.

abort.already_configured: This scale is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No supported scale is advertising. Step on the scale and retry.
abort.not_supported: That device uses the same Bluetooth service as a supported scale, but its readings are in a format this integration does not decode.

init.title: People
init.description: Height, age and sex are required to estimate body composition; without them only weight and impedance are reported. Readings are assigned by weight, with a linked person entity breaking ties when two people are close in weight.
